summary: BIONIC™ Geospatial Data Integration testing completed successfully. All 24 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend displays real-time data section with LIVE badge showing weather from Open-Meteo (-12.3°C), terrain from Open-Elevation (55m), and vegetation indices (NDVI: 0.22) from seasonal estimates.
critical_code_review_comments: Geospatial data integration is well-implemented with proper caching (5-minute TTL)
Helper functions (weather_to_bionic_factors, terrain_to_bionic_factors, vegetation_to_bionic_factors) correctly convert real data to BIONIC scores
Error handling is robust with fallback to simulated data when APIs fail
Frontend 'Données en temps réel' section displays all 3 data sources with proper formatting
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_geospatial_apis.py - Created 24 comprehensive tests for geospatial APIs
seed_data_creation: No seed data needed - uses real external APIs
context_for_next_testing_agent: Geospatial integration fully tested. APIs: GET /api/bionic/geospatial/weather (Open-Meteo), GET /api/bionic/geospatial/terrain (Open-Elevation), GET /api/bionic/geospatial/vegetation (seasonal estimates), GET /api/bionic/geospatial/complete (all data). POST /api/bionic/analyze now includes real_conditions and data_sources in response.

geospatial_complete_api.notes: Returns all weather, terrain, vegetation data in one call

bionic_analyze_real_conditions.notes: Response includes real_conditions object with weather, terrain, vegetation data

bionic_analyze_data_sources.notes: Response includes data_sources array listing all sources used

frontend_real_time_section.notes: 'Données en temps réel' section displays with LIVE badge, shows all 3 data categories

frontend_data_sources_display.notes: Sources displayed at bottom: 'Open-Meteo • Open-Elevation • Seasonal Estimate'

geospatial_caching.notes: 5-minute cache working correctly to avoid repeated API calls

mocked_apis_note: MOCKED: NDVI/NDWI uses seasonal estimates based on NASA MODIS typical values (not live satellite data). Weather (Open-Meteo) and Terrain (Open-Elevation) are 100% REAL data from external APIs.
